title: OIR source
description: A retrievable origin. `derived_from` is mandatory (may be empty) and is the mechanism that prevents syndicated copy from being counted as independent corroboration.

tier.description: Tiers are judged by different standards and are never pooled into one credibility score.

derived_from.description: Root sources this one reproduces, translates, or reports on. Empty array means this is a root. A cycle is a validation failure.

independence_class.description: root = contributes 1 to the effective independent count; derived = contributes 0; unknown = counted as 1 but flagged.

interest_note.description: Who benefits from this being believed. Required for official and social tiers; optional elsewhere.

access.description: unreachable sources may be cited as reported, never as verified.

quote.description: Exact wording when a specific phrase is load-bearing.
